assembly_sequence.action: Place base on flat surface with open top up.
Insert pin into base knuckles from +Y side until head contacts the outer face of the +Y knuckle.
assembly_sequence.final_retention: Pin is held by friction in base knuckles (interference fit) and later captured by lid knuckle.

assembly_sequence.access: Open end of +Y knuckle and top opening
assembly_sequence.action: Slide lid knuckle onto pin from +Y side, aligning bore with pin, and push lid downward until it sits over the base opening. The snap tab will deflect outward as it passes the front wall, then engage the latch recess.
assembly_sequence.final_retention: Lid is retained by pin through knuckles and snap tab engagement.
